primarySources.verifiedClaim: Matching percentages require contextual review; correct quotations can match. ByteVerse uses neither Turnitin's corpus nor its scoring method.

Quotation, close paraphrase, borrowed ideas and reuse of assessed work require attention to attribution and the applicable institution's policy. Small wording changes are not sufficient evidence of independent work.
Original useful evidence, comprehensive answers and trustworthy sourcing matter. There is no preferred word count or guaranteed ranking outcome.

Ordinary duplicate URLs are not a blanket spam penalty; scraped content differs. Keyword stuffing and magical length targets are not a sound strategy. Links, discovery and many other signals still matter.
